effect:
Restores lowered stats once. (Hold)

White Herb automatically restores your stat drops to normal once, then is consumed. This activates even on self-inflicted stat drops from moves like Close Combat!

A classic combo is with moves that drop your stats, then you get the powerful attack without the drawback! It also counters Intimidate or other stat-lowering abilities on the switch. Niche but effective!
